_note: DEFAULT-DENY allowance for the skip gate (tests/skip_gate.py). Every skip reason that occurs, whatever its wording, must appear here with its exact count; there is no allow-list of 'known' wordings. classify()/COMPILE_ENV_PATTERNS only label the log lines and name which reasons the 'engine_built' profile pins at 0. Keys are the EXACT skip reason text (a renamed reason is drift too). 'default' is the profile the engine-less hosted-CI pytest job runs; its counts are the WHOLE skip population of the measured run (2,358 skips across 13 reasons), not only the compile-environment ones. 'engine_built' is the profile the engine-building CI job runs: the compile-environment reasons are pinned at 0 so any such skip fails that job; see _engine_built_note.
_measured_on: 2026-10-11 spot box (Ubuntu 24.04, python 3.12), engine-less with NO PINEFORGE_* variables set; the counts are the WHOLE skip population of that run (2,358 skips across 13 reasons), not only the compile-environment skips
_engine_built_note: The engine-building CI job runs this profile. Its compile-environment reasons are pinned at 0 because building the engine must remove every one. The other counts are copies of the engine-less measurement and are EXPECTED to be corrected from this job's own first run: when a count is wrong the gate prints the exact row to write here, which is how this profile is meant to be filled.
